lead_headline: Recess Beer Garden expands to Auraria Campus, Call Your Mother Deli lands near Union Station, Challengers Sports Bar closes Aurora location

restaurant.blurb: 3 new leads: Recess opens Tivoli Student Union location, Call Your Mother Deli lands near Union Station, Mynt tavern replaces BoyzTown cabaret. Closures: Challengers Sports Bar (Aurora), Old Zeppelin Station food hall effectively shuttered.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Wednesday — third straight day with no filings as administrative freeze continues. 3 status changes: Old Santa Fe Mexican Grill reactivated (from delinquent), Art Gym Denver slides delinquent, South Broadway Country Club back online. Week total: 6 applications vs. prior week's 263 (anomaly-inflated). Normal cadence solidifies — system runs at typical 5-8 weekly baseline after last week's backlog purge. Two-week pattern clear: Wednesday's 267-filing spike was administrative catch-up, not recurring volume.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Wednesday pushes citation blackout to 15 consecutive days — longest gap in BusinessDen's monitored history. Zero active sources, all-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 lifetime outlets. Past 30 days: 86 mentions (down from 98 yesterday as early-August citations age out). Two-week freeze now exceeds all prior holiday lulls and seasonal dips — points to systemic syndication breakdown, monitoring infrastructure failure, or major editorial cycle shift rather than normal variance. No precedent for 15-day silence in outlet's tracking record.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +9 yesterday (14 new, 5 canceled) as Tuesday acquisition jumps to strongest single-day performance in two weeks. MTD climbs to +12 (+0.6/day) while 90-day net reaches +85. Past 7 days: +30 net (47 new, 17 canceled) vs. prior week's −20 — clean 50-subscriber swing driven by sustained low churn (17 vs. 38 cancellations) and steady new-subscriber flow. Recent two weeks show bifurcated pattern: Week 1 bled −20 on heavy cancellations (38), Week 2 gains +30 as churn discipline holds (17) and acquisition pace accelerates. MTD momentum builds as August stabilizes after early-month drag — year-long trend (+228 YTD, +1.0/day) confirms structural health beneath weekly noise.
